[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. Then, if you have one counter or more, you can return this card to your Hand. This "return to hand" effect can only be used once per turn.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14299.name: Wandering Grandwalker Lolo
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14299.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Clown/Primal & Cost 3 or more, Rebirth Spirit) (Rebirth Nexus)]
◆When you summon/advent/deploy a target Spirit/Nexus, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control any Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name as this card, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you are summoning a "Primal" family Spirit card, this Nexus' symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Draw a card. Or, if you have two or less counters, flip a pre-Rebirth Nexus you control.
